info.title: GovCon OCI & FAR 9.5 Mitigation Plan Generator API
info.description: Audits existing Prime/Sub SETA, A&AS, IV&V, or Systems Engineering contracts against a new Federal or SLED solicitation under FAR Subpart 9.5 (9.505-1 through 9.505-4), DFARS 252.209-7008 / 252.209-7009, and GAO OCI case law across all 3 statutory OCI pillars (Unequal Access to Information, Biased Ground Rules, and Impaired Objectivity), outputting a 3-pillar risk matrix, technical/organizational firewall controls, firewalled subcontractor workshare allocation, and a paste-ready OCI Disclosure & Mitigation Plan Volume.

post.summary: Generate FAR Subpart 9.5 Organizational Conflict of Interest (OCI) Audit & Mitigation Plan
post.operationId: Generate FAR Subpart 9.5 Organizational Conflict of Interest (OCI) Audit & Mitigation Plan

new_solicitation_scope_and_oci_clauses.description: Target solicitation PWS/SOW scope, Section H/I/K/L OCI disclosure instructions, and applicable FAR Subpart 9.5 / DFARS 252.209-7008 / agency OCI clauses (min 20 chars).
new_solicitation_scope_and_oci_clauses.example: SOLICITATION FA8802-27-R-0014 (USSF Space Systems Command DevSecOps & Ground C2 Integration). Section H.8 OCI Notice (FAR Subpart 9.5 / DFARS 252.209-7008 & 252.209-7009): Offerors performing Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) or Advisory & Assistance Services (A&AS) across USSF SSC shall disclose all active contracts and submit a comprehensive Organizational Conflict of Interest (OCI) Mitigation Plan addressing Unequal Access to Information, Biased Ground Rules, and Impaired Objectivity.

existing_contracts_and_corporate_relatio.description: Active or recent Prime/Sub awards, SETA/A&AS/IV&V support contracts, parent/affiliate relationships, and proposed teaming partners (min 20 chars).
existing_contracts_and_corporate_relatio.example: Prime Offeror (Aegis Federal Cyber LLC) holds USSF SSC SETA Task Order FA8802-24-F-0091 in Division B (El Segundo, CA) providing enterprise architecture studies. Division A (Colorado Springs, CO) is bidding on FA8802-27-R-0014 with zero personnel overlap, separate Microsoft 365 GCC High / AWS GovCloud IL5 enclaves, and conflict-free subcontractor Vanguard Orbital Testing LLC assigned 100% of independent verification & validation (IV&V) tasks.

proposed_mitigation_posture.description: Preferred FAR Subpart 9.5 OCI mitigation architecture.
